examples.title: Form Input with Label
examples.code:
<Box gap="xs">
  <Text as="label" htmlFor="email" fontSize="s" fontWeight="medium">
    Email Address
  </Text>
  <Field 
    id="email"
    as="input" 
    type="email" 
    variant="outline" 
    $size="medium"
  />
</Box>
examples.description: Accessible form input with connected label
examples.commonUse: Contact forms, login forms, any user input

examples.title: Card Component
examples.code:
<Box skin="card" p="m" shape="rounded" gap="s">
  <Text as="h3" fontSize="l" fontWeight="bold">Card Title</Text>
  <Text as="p" fontSize="s" color="secondary">Card content goes here</Text>
  <Button variant="primary" $size="small">Learn More</Button>
</Box>
examples.description: Elevated card container with content and action

examples.title: Responsive Grid Layout
examples.code:
<Box 
  display="grid" 
  gridTemplateColumns={["1fr", "1fr 1fr", "1fr 1fr 1fr"]} 
  gap="m"
>
  {items.map(item => (
    <Box key={item.id} skin="card" p="m">
      <Text>{item.name}</Text>
    </Box>
  ))}
</Box>
examples.description: Mobile-first responsive grid that adapts columns by screen size
examples.commonUse: Product grids, image galleries, dashboard widgets

examples.title: Flex Layout - Space Between
examples.code:
<Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" p="m">
  <Text as="h1" fontSize="xl" fontWeight="bold">Dashboard</Text>
  <Button variant="primary" $size="medium">New Project</Button>
</Box>
examples.description: Header layout with title and action on opposite ends

examples.title: Form Field with Error State
examples.code:
<Box gap="xs">
  <Text as="label" htmlFor="username" fontSize="s" fontWeight="medium">
    Username
  </Text>
  <Field 
    id="username"
    as="input" 
    type="text" 
    variant="outline" 
    $size="medium"
    error
  />
  <Text fontSize="xs" color="error">
    Username is already taken
  </Text>
</Box>
examples.description: Form field with validation error message

examples.title: Loading State Indicator
Textarea Input Field
examples.code:

  <Text as="label" htmlFor="description" fontSize="s" fontWeight="medium">
    Description
  </Text>
  <Field 
    id="description"

examples.title: Select Dropdown Field
examples.code:
<Box gap="xs">
  <Text as="label" htmlFor="country" fontSize="s" fontWeight="medium">
    Country
  </Text>
  <Field id="country" as="select" variant="outline" $size="medium">
    <option value="">Select a country</option>
    <option value="us">United States</option>
    <option value="uk">United Kingdom</option>
  </Field>
</Box>
examples.commonUse: Country selectors, category pickers, option lists

criticalReminders: Button and Field use $size (with $), not size
Box and Text use size (without $) for generic sizing
Always connect labels to inputs with htmlFor/id
Always specify 'as' prop on Text for semantic HTML
Use theme tokens, not arbitrary pixel values
